description: A car passing too close in a narrow lane touched my door and left a small scratch.
I had a few too many drinks at a party and then drove home. My licence expired two years ago and I never renewed it. I hit a parked truck.

Last Sunday we went to my cousin's engagement in Madurai. It was raining and the traffic was heavy. On the way back my father called to ask about the function and my wife was telling me about the food. In the middle of all this a goat ran onto the road, I braked hard, and a white van behind me could not stop and hit my rear. The rear bumper is cracked and the boot does not close properly.
I smoked weed with friends in the evening and then drove home. I lost control and hit a divider.
Smoke came from under the bonnet while my car was parked outside my office. The fire brigade came. The engine and the front seats are burnt.
A scooter touched my car at a signal and cracked the tail light.
